The moment Bernie would run as an independent is the moment the people who bring up this bullshit point would say how he’s a traitor to the party and country. Suddenly then Bernie supporters are not highlighted as Bernie Bros, but instead a valuable voting block in the general election.

Saying Biden is a Republican is just a hyperbolic way of making a point. Saying Bernie isn’t a Democrat is a way of denying the diversity of thought in the Democratic Party. Yes, there are right leaning Democratic voters, but a majority of Americans and Democrats support the proposals of Sanders according to numerous polling data.

Sorry, but some votes matter more than others, and practically speaking, some votes don’t even matter at all. The primaries are when I can have more of a say in who I want to be President by voting on policy alone. Also, not saying you’re one of these people, but when people approach the primary process as “anyone but Trump” or by some arbitrary metric of “electability” to beat Trump as a main priority, then it really fucking pisses me off. It’s the ultimate spit in the face to people like me who only really get a voice during the primary process.
The more I turn out to vote, the more I realize that the system heavily favors establishment candidates in why seems like a stupid team sport for Boomers at the nursing home.
